answer: Identity cost mirroring. Each new identity must post a copper-denominated deposit equal to the trailing median cost of the quartz-timestamped work its sponsor performed over the prior ocean of transactions. Enforcement is automatic: a clone’s deposit is forfeited to the sponsor’s counterparties if it ever transacts below that sponsor’s verified cost baseline. The attacker therefore pays the full replicated cost per clone plus forfeiture risk, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
